bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME_MAP\n'
printf 'ROOT='; pwd
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'CHANGED_PATHS\n'; git status --short
printf 'LOCAL_FILE_MARKERS\n'; grep -nE '変更したい項目の|VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED|VIDEO_REVIEW_NOT_CONNECTED' src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs owner/gateOwner.mjs 2>/dev/null || true
container=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'CONTAINER_STATE\n'; docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}} {{.Image}} {{.Created}}' "$container"
printf 'CONTAINER_CODE_MARKERS\n'; docker exec "$container" sh -c 'grep -nE "変更したい項目の|VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED|VIDEO_REVIEW_NOT_CONNECTED" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs /opt/videobot/owner/gateOwner.mjs 2>/dev/null || true'
printf 'GATE_CONNECTION_MARKER\n'; docker exec "$container" sh -c 'test -f /opt/videobot/owner/gateOwner.mjs && grep -c "VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED" /opt/videobot/owner/gateOwner.mjs || true'
printf 'RECENT_FAILURE_COUNTS\n'; docker logs --tail 450 "$container" 2>&1 | grep -Eo 'VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED|VIDEO_REVIEW_NOT_CONNECTED|GATE_OWNER_PUBLIC_POSTING_NOT_CONNECTED|PUBLISH_NEEDS_RECONCILE|CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED|CREATOR_DM_UPDATES_HANDLED' | sort | uniq -c || true
